items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: I said, I listen to Buddy, I'm going to lend him a horn.

ctx.x: He looked at all. He looked at all.

He looked at all. I said, Pike. And he said, that George Jones and a whole lot of the other folks coming up South I thought he was standing looking. I said, that's the best band. Two bands, you know? That's two bands. Yeah, you see, that's the best band. He said, Frank, why'd you get that band? You can scrape it from the club. He said, I got it. So he, he said, Joe, you want to play it in the rhythm? I said, no, I don't know. I don't know, I don't know. I like his way, you know. I don't know. I don't know. Yeah,…
Well, tell us something about Buddy Petit. He said, you know what Buddy said?
